appContext.category: AI nutrition tracking and meal analysis
appContext.summary: PrecisionCal turns a photo of any meal into a nutritional autopsy: it identifies every ingredient including sauces and garnishes, estimates realistic portion weights, and reconciles fat/carb/protein totals with full transparency. It decodes barcode packaged foods with additive-risk ratings, offers the Ask Cal AI guide, a Today dashboard with hydration and PhD breakdowns, trends analytics, the Sanctuary community, and a Pro subscription with a 3-day free trial. Warm ivory, terracotta and sage aesthetic.

theme.style: A warm editorial wellness world of creamy ivory, sun-baked terracotta and soft sage, like morning light falling across a linen-draped kitchen table. Textures are tactile and natural: matte clay, washed linen, soft plaster and gentle paper grain, lit by low golden daylight with long soft shadows. Most backgrounds stay airy and calm. Two deeper moments, espresso-brown and deep sage, add richness and forensic focus without losing warmth. Organic rounded botanical shapes and soft clay arcs recur as quiet motifs.
